name: Apple Inc. (Apple ID & Developer Portal)
data_summary: Your Apple ID email, password, and two-factor code are submitted directly to Apple servers (gsa.apple.com / developer.apple.com) to generate signing certificates and provisioning profiles. The Developer never receives these credentials.

name: Anisette Authentication Server
data_summary: Simulates macOS/iCloud device attestation headers (X-Apple-I-MD-M / X-Apple-I-MD) required for Apple ID login. Apple ID login payloads pass through the configured anisette server. Only use servers you trust.

name: SideStore
data_summary: Installs on the target iOS device to manage app refreshing over a local loopback VPN using your pairing record. No user data is transmitted to SideStore maintainers; pairing records remain on your local devices.

name: LiveContainer
data_summary: Executes guest iOS apps inside a shared entitlement container without consuming additional free developer App ID slots. All execution occurs completely locally on the iOS device.

name: StikDebug
data_summary: Facilitates debugserver pairing and JIT enablement on iOS 17+. Tunnel negotiation occurs over local USB or Wi-Fi sockets directly between the Android phone and iOS device.

name: Public Download Hosts & Repositories
data_summary: When downloading IPAs or developer disk images from remote URLs (such as GitHub Releases), your Android device's IP address and standard HTTP request headers are received by the host.

name: libimobiledevice & usbmuxd
data_summary: Open-source software libraries communicating with iOS services over raw USB sockets. All protocol negotiation and data parsing happens completely on-device without internet access.

name: pymobiledevice3
data_summary: Python implementation of RemoteXPC, RemotePairing, and CoreDevice. Runs locally inside Chaquopy on your Android device.

name: zsign
data_summary: Parses Mach-O binaries and code directories locally, signs them using your .p12 certificate and provisioning profile, and repacks the IPA on-device.

name: libsu
data_summary: Manages communication with the Android system root daemon (Magisk/KernelSU) to spawn usbmuxd and grant raw USB device file access.

name: GitHub Inc. (Releases & Updates)
data_summary: When in-app update checks are enabled, the app contacts the GitHub Releases API to discover new versions and download signed APKs. GitHub receives your IP address and standard HTTP request headers. No personal data or device identifiers are sent.
